# Solar panel cleaning

Pollen season leaves a fine yellow film on the small solar panel at each
station. It is normally harmless for a few weeks, but cleaning it after the
main spring fall gives the AWS battery the best margin before the next long
spell of dull weather.

## Field method

Use clean water and a soft lint-free cloth. Wipe the panel while it is cool,
working from the upper edge down, and do not use solvents, abrasive pads, or
a pressure washer. Check that the panel bracket has not moved while the
station is being serviced.

## Seasonal timing

Schedule the shared cleaning round after visible pollen has finished, usually
before the summer grass-cut visits. Midwinter cleaning is only needed when
bird droppings or mud visibly shade the panel; low sun then makes every
uncovered part of the panel useful. Record a panel that remains cloudy after
cleaning so its cover can be checked at the next station visit.
